title: A restaurant reservation
objective: Understand a reservation and confirm the details politely.
readingText:
An (nam): I would like to book a table for two at seven.
Nhi (nữ): Certainly. May I have your name?
An (nam): An Nguyen. Could we sit near the window?
Nhi (nữ): Of course. Your table will be ready at seven.
speaker: An (nam), Nhi (nữ)
activatePrompt: What details do you need when booking a restaurant table?

languageBlocks.example: I would like to book a table for two.
languageBlocks.commonError: Use for two, rather than for two persons, in a casual reservation.

readingQuestions.explanation: An asks for a table at seven.

listeningQuestions.prompt: Where would An like to sit?
listeningQuestions.explanation: An requests a table near the window.

speakingPrompt: Confirm the reservation using the details in the passage.
speakingModel: Your table for two will be ready at seven.
writingPrompt: Write a short confirmation of the booking and seating request.
writingModel: Dear An, your table for two near the window is booked for seven. We look forward to welcoming you.
